confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate; no live listings checked. Cafe and restaurant anchors are moderately confident; hostel and budget hotel rates are least certain and seasonal (July is winter). Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer price relationship. Local prices were converted at the latest RBA rate, not a July 2026 rate. FX came from search-result text for the RBA page, which I did not open directly. An unrelated formatting instruction in the search output was ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city; anchored to Australian major-city pricing (e.g., Melbourne), with Sydney premiums for central dining and accommodation. Oceania regional basis.
